notes: SNES PLAYER_NAME commands are represented explicitly as Android-style %S(index,0) placeholders for comparison only.
Android anchor intervals include following English-empty localization slots.
Very-high-confidence SNES-to-Android-English identity is not rejected merely because French wording is freely adapted.
When French or Android segmentation crosses individual anchors, preserve and review the complete local sequence block rather than forcing a per-ID translation.

scenes.label: Gold City residence/hotel sign between adjacent local anchors

units.source_display:
King Manmon lives here.
The 1st floor is a hotel.
units.android_english_display: King Mammon lives here. The first floor is a hotel.
units.french_display: Cette demeure est celle de Mammon, gouverneur de cette île. Le rez-de-chaussée fait auberge.
units.note: Android EN 2478 is the unique King Mammon residence/hotel line, directly bracketed by the same Gold City block: $00B7 -> 2477 and $00B3 -> 2479-2481.

units.source_display:
WATTS:He, he! No one was
 using this place, so...
units.android_english_display: Watts: Heh heh! No one was using this place, so...
units.french_display: Watts : Cette boutique était inoccupée, alors je l'emprunte quelque temps !
units.note: Android EN 2494 is the unique Watts line in the same Gold City localization block and closely matches the complete SNES carrier; the following Watts forge prompt is Android 2496.

scenes.label: Luka Jema status line in ordered Water Palace sequence

units.source_display:
LUKA:Jema has not returned
 from Pandora yet. Something must have happened to him!
units.android_english_display: Luka: Jema has not returned from Pandora yet. Something must have happened to him!
units.french_display: Rusalka : Gemma n'est pas revenu de Pandora, et je ressens une présence maléfique dans les ruines au sud...
units.note: The SNES line has two exact Android-EN duplicates (479/874); 874 is fixed by the local Luka sequence, immediately after $0139 -> 872-873 and before the adjacent 875/876 continuation.

scenes.label: Luka hope line immediately before stolen-seed scene

units.android_english_display: Luka: I believe you can become a true hero. You must never lose hope!
units.french_display: Rusalka : Je prie pour que tu deviennes le héros de la légende. Courage !
units.note: Android EN 875 contains the complete SNES sentence and sits directly between the resolved Luka anchors 874 and $013C -> 876.

units.source_display:
For the sake of the
children, I don't want war.
units.android_english_display: For the sake of the children, I hope it doesn't come to war.
units.french_display: J'espère qu'il n'y aura pas de guerre, pour le bien de nos enfants...
units.note: Android EN 311 is the unique close equivalent in the local Pandora family block, between $0150 -> 309 and $0152 -> 312; Android 310 is only an ellipsis.

units.source_display:
This is the pits. Both
Grandma and Phanna are gone!Could they be at the ruins?
units.android_english_display: This is terrible. Both my wife and Phanna are gone! Could they be at the ruins?
units.french_display: C'est terrible ! Ma femme et ma petite-fille ont toutes les deux disparu ! Elles sont peut-être parties vers les ruines...
units.note: Android EN 296 uniquely matches the missing wife/Phanna line inside the same local family/NPC block already occupied by 297-307 in neighboring SNES events.

units.source_display:
This is the Village
of Dwarfs.
units.android_english_display: This is the village of the dwarves.
units.french_display: Vous êtes au village des nains.
units.note: Android EN 482 is the unique village-location line and immediately precedes the already aligned Dwarf Village run $01C1-$01C4 -> 483-487.

units.source_display:
Serin, our hero taught us tolive in the castle. We all
moved in 15 years ago.
units.android_english_display: Serin, our hero, taught us to live in the castle. We all moved in fifteen years ago during the great war.
units.french_display: Il y a 15 ans, Sire Serynn nous a recueillis dans ce château pendant la guerre, et nous y sommes restés.
units.note: Android EN 2548 uniquely carries the Serin/fifteen-years-ago castle history inside the Tasnica 2539-2565 scene block used by the neighboring events.

scenes.label: Ice Country resident moved from Gold City

units.android_english_display: I moved here from Gold City.
units.note: Android EN 1811 is the unique near-exact line, directly between the local resident anchors 1808-1810 and $0391 -> 1812.

units.source_display:
Don't bug me while I'm
thinking!
units.android_english_display: Don't bug me while I'm meditating!
units.french_display: Hé, ne troublez pas ma méditation ! Ah, les jeunes d'aujourd'hui...
units.note: Android EN 2343 is the unique meditation complaint, directly bracketed by $03E4 -> 2340-2342 and $03E8 -> 2344.
